name: gama-finance
description: GAMA FINANCE - aplicativo financeiro web e Android

scripts.android:prepare: node scripts/prepare-android.mjs && esbuild native-back.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=www/native-back.js && esbuild firebase-client.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=www/firebase-client.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run android:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:prepare && npx cap sync android
